findings.title: discount_for_tier now returns percent; checkout still treats it as a fraction
findings.claim: discount_for_tier changed its contract from a fraction (0.0-1.0) to a percentage (0-100), but final_price in checkout.rs still computes base * (1.0 - d).
findings.trigger: final_price(100.0, "gold"): d is now 20.0, so the price becomes 100 * (1.0 - 20.0) = -1900 instead of 80.
findings.impact: Every tiered checkout price is negative or wildly wrong.

supporting_evidence.note: base * (1.0 - d) assumes d is a fraction

arguments.coverage: checked callers of discount_for_tier via vera_references (checkout.rs, tests); read src/checkout.rs

counterevidence_checked: read src/checkout.rs:5-6 — caller computes base*(1.0-d), confirming the percent value is treated as a fraction
arguments.rationale: caller treats the returned percent as a fraction; trigger reachable via any tiered checkout
